name: Random.seed
note: review: seedConvert/pySeed mirror :146-174 (the v1 latin-1 hash, the v2 str/bytes/bytearray SHA-512 int, the TypeError, then super().seed), but no entry says what reaches super().seed: SeedStrBytesAgree and the str/bytes half of SeedV1Hash are equalities between seed calls, SeedV2AllBits and the range half of SeedV1Hash are about the helpers alone, and SeedAllOrNothing/InitMatchesSeed hold of any seed, so a seed that seeded every argument with 0 passes all six.

name: Random.__getstate__
note: review: The body is return self.getstate() (:214), and its only statement is the PickleRoundTrip conjunct pyDunderGetstate o = pyReduce o, where both are pyGetstate by definition: an alias restated as rfl. Unpickling never calls it (__reduce__ is defined, :210-212).

name: Random._randbelow_with_getrandbits
note: review: randbelowWith mirrors the k = n.bit_length() draw and the rejection loop (:248-252), but RandbelowInRange only says the result is < n (and a fact about 2**bit_length), which always-0 also satisfies; the withdrawal stands.

name: Random._randbelow_without_getrandbits
note: review: randbelowWithout mirrors both branches (:260-272) over an abstract Flt, not Binary64; RandbelowWithoutInRange is range-only for n < 2**53 (always 0 passes), and the n >= 2**53 bound is the open entry rand-randbelow-without-huge.

name: Random.choice
note: review: choice mirrors the two len() calls and seq[_randbelow(len)] (:352-354), but ChoiceSpec is membership (seq[j] for some j in range), which always seq[0] satisfies; the withdrawal stands.

name: Random.shuffle
note: review: shuffleLoop mirrors the reversed(range(1, len(x))) swap loop (:359-363), but ShuffleSpec says only that the result is a permutation and does not raise, and ShuffleImmutable is the TypeError after one draw; the identity permutation passes both, so the withdrawal stands.

name: Random.sample
note: review: sample mirrors the Sequence check, the counts branch (accumulate, pop, the total checks, bisect), setsize and both loops (:420-458); but SampleDistinctPositions is positions only and SampleCountsEquivalent is a twin that \"always the first k\" also satisfies, and the negative-counts refutation (probe: counts=[3, -1] gives ['a', 'a']) runs only the total < 0 check.

name: Random.choices
note: review: choices mirrors the plain, weights and cum_weights branches and their errors (:466-495) over an abstract Flt, not Binary64; ChoicesSpec is k items each population[j] with k draws, which always population[0] satisfies. The in-range claim is the open entry rand-choices-index-in-range.

name: Random.uniform
note: review: Floats are the abstract Flt class (Lean Float in the difftest, no Binary64 instance), and OneDraw says only that one random() is used, so any function of that draw passes; the range claim is the open entry rand-uniform-range.

name: Random.triangular
note: review: Draw count only (OneDraw), over an abstract Flt rather than Binary64: any function of the one draw passes, including on the ZeroDivisionError path.

name: Random.normalvariate
note: review: RejectionDraws says only that draws come in pairs; with an abstract Flt rather than Binary64, any function of the same draws passes.

name: Random.gauss
note: review: GaussDraws pins two draws, or none, and whether gauss_next is filled or emptied, but no value: a gauss returning 0.0 with the same caching passes. Floats are an abstract Flt, not Binary64.

name: Random.lognormvariate
note: review: Draw counts only (RejectionDraws), over an abstract Flt rather than Binary64; any function of the same draws passes.

name: Random.expovariate
note: review: Draw count only (OneDraw), over an abstract Flt rather than Binary64; any function of the one draw passes.

name: Random.vonmisesvariate
note: review: RejectionDraws is a draw count. The refutation VonmisesExitsForSomeDraws is built on NanF, a two-value toy algebra, not Binary64, and covers only kappa = nan, though the hang itself is real (probe: vonmisesvariate(0, nan) did not return within 3 s). No value is pinned.

name: Random.gammavariate
note: review: GammaChecksFirst pins the ValueError for alpha <= 0 or beta <= 0 before any draw, and RejectionDraws the draw shape, but no value: a constant passes. The NaN refutation runs on the NanF toy algebra, not Binary64 (probe: gammavariate(nan, 1.0) hangs).

name: Random.betavariate
note: review: Draw counts only (RejectionDraws) over an abstract Flt; the gamma-exits refutation it shares has no betavariate case of its own, and no value is pinned.

name: Random.paretovariate
note: review: Draw count only (OneDraw), over an abstract Flt rather than Binary64; any function of the one draw passes.

name: Random.weibullvariate
note: review: Draw count only (OneDraw), over an abstract Flt rather than Binary64; any function of the one draw passes.

name: Random.binomialvariate
note: review: BinomialEdges pins n < 0, p == 0 -> 0, p == 1 -> n and one draw for n == 1, but nothing on the BG/BTRS paths, so any whole-draw function passes there. The NaN refutation is sound (probe: binomialvariate(5, nan) raises AssertionError, binomialvariate(1, nan) gives 0) but runs on NanF, and the range claim is the open entry rand-binomial-range.

name: SystemRandom.random
note: review: SysRandomBound is ok-implies (numerator < 2**53) on an abstract os.urandom, which always raising satisfies, and the float product is an abstract Flt, not Binary64; the withdrawal stands.

name: SystemRandom.getrandbits
note: review: sysGetrandbits raises TypeError for any float, but :912 compares k < 0 first (probe: SystemRandom().getrandbits(-1.5) raises ValueError 'number of bits must be non-negative'; 2.5 gives the TypeError); and SysGetrandbitsBound is ok-implies on an abstract source, which always raising satisfies.

name: SystemRandom.randbytes
note: review: sysRandbytes is _urandom(n) with the clinic and negative-size checks; SysRandbytes is length on success (ok-implies, always raising passes) plus the negative ValueError, so the withdrawal stands.

name: SystemRandom.seed
note: review: The body is a docstring and return None (:925-926); SysNoState proves it with rfl on a constant stub, which AGENTS.md says does not count. It belongs in the tsv as no-behaviour:, not modelled.

name: SystemRandom._notimplemented
note: review: The body is one constant raise of NotImplementedError (:930), and SysNoState proves it with rfl on that constant; this is rfl on a one-line definition, not coverage.

name: _test_generator
note: test-support: timing and summary-statistics printer for the module self-test

name: _test
note: test-support: runs _test_generator over a fixed list of calls

name: _parse_args
note: review: test-support does not apply: this is the argparse parser of the documented `python -m random` CLI (mutually exclusive -c/-i/-f, type=int/float conversion with SystemExit 2 on bad input, the help text main returns), not test support; \"argparse is not in this area\" is a scope choice, not one of the exclusion reasons.

name: main
note: review: cliMain mirrors the option order and the positional int/float/split fallbacks, the refutation (bug corelibs-random-cli-positional-int-fallback; probe: main(['0']) == 0.0) and MainPositionalPositive/MainChoices are sound; but the --test branch is modelled as returning \"\" for any nonzero N, while _test raises for N < 2 (probe: main(['--test', '1']) raises StatisticsError 'stdev requires at least two data points', and --test -1 'fmean requires at least one data point').
